notes: Named only in the invention title at field (54), 一种除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺, so the role is the target product of the process the patent claims. 环磺酮 is the standard Chinese common name for tembotrione and the document renders it that way itself on the EN line, so resolution is supported inside the section. is_section_product is false because this section is bibliographic metadata and is not headed by a compound; it is headed by the issuing office line. No chemical_family or functional_group tag is emitted: unlike a title that prints a compound class, this title prints only 除草剂 (herbicide), and the section gives no structure, chemical name or formula. The Int.Cl. codes at field (51) are classification symbols and are not treated as compound identifiers.
